MDG.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is stated only inside customs, a sector system.

facts.fact: Madagascar's customs director general told an IMF panel on 27 March 2025 that the AI-based Enhanced Risk Assessment tool, with a data warehouse operational since late 2024, analyses millions of Sydonia records, with automated controls cutting clearance times and predictive analysis strengthening the fight against fraud.

MDG.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: Madagascar's customs administration says it analyses millions of records from SYDONIA, its customs management platform, and that automated controls have reduced clearance times.
